questions.question: You said the margin tile ("Safe · stocks can fall 68.5% before a margin call") isn't useful. What should go in its place?
questions.why: The designer cannot replace the tile without knowing what it should show instead.
questions.answer: things like buying power, margin excess net liq

questions.question: You said "things like buying power, margin excess net liq". Is that the full list for the tile, or are there other numbers you want there too?
questions.why: "Things like" leaves the tile's contents open; the designer cannot decide what else, if anything, belongs in it.

questions.question: Since most accounts are real, what should happen to the few simulated ones?
questions.why: "Most" means some accounts are simulated; the designer cannot tell whether to drop the marking everywhere or keep it only for those.
choices: Keep the marking only in account settings

questions.question: What looks off about the top, and what should be there?
questions.why: "There's no top" doesn't say what is missing; the designer cannot tell whether to add a header or rework the existing band.
choices: Add a proper header bar at the top
Restyle the band so it reads as the top

questions.question: You asked to show analysis instead of alerts, so the Alerts tab becomes an Analysis tab. What should Analysis show you?
questions.why: The designer cannot fill the Analysis tab without knowing its content.
choices: Same as the current RollCall analysis page
questions.answer: look at current roll call's analysis page

questions.question: With analysis replacing alerts, should alerts still be reachable somewhere?
questions.why: "Instead of alerts" doesn't say whether alerts are dropped or moved; the designer cannot decide where, or if, they live.
choices: Yes, a bell icon at the top

questions.question: How much of the current RollCall analysis page should the Analysis tab carry over?
questions.why: The designer needs to know whether to copy the whole page or only parts of it.
choices: All of it, as it is today
Only the parts I'll point out
I'll share a screenshot to work from

questions.question: Which screens do you expect to find in More?
questions.why: The designer cannot fill More without knowing which screens belong there.
choices: All screens of the current RollCall

questions.question: The premium summary shouldn't always be present. Should it be collapsible, and if so, open or collapsed at first?
questions.why: He said "maybe" collapsible; the designer cannot choose how it hides and its starting state.

questions.question: What should the full ladder show for this roll?
questions.why: "Full ladder" could mean strikes, expirations or both; the designer cannot lay it out without knowing.
choices: All strikes for the next expiry

questions.question: When you pick a rung from the ladder, what should happen?
questions.why: The designer cannot tell whether picking replaces the suggested roll or goes straight to an order.
choices: It replaces the suggested roll on the card
It goes straight to the order
